Read/replay retained evidence locally without network or write; missing/incompatible evidence fails typed and never refetches.

Declare retention class; unknown is UNCLASSIFIED_REQUIRES_POLICY and not deletion authority.

Evidence-family schema evolution must preserve historical Result/Audit/artifact readability or provide an explicit compatible transition; installation-state migration policy is not inferred from evidence schema changes.

obligations: Existing Unified HTTP routes inherit loopback-only exposure, 1 MiB ingress, 8 MiB public projection and per-process fail-fast concurrency ceiling 1.

Use server-owned authorization and contained roots; payload fields cannot choose command, module, adapter, registry, source URL, executable or output root.

Source/agent/evidence content remains data, never control-plane authority; new output surfaces require hostile-content and secret-canary review.
No family-owned generic network, retention, resource, secret or authorization policy.

rationale: Existing Unified Request, version-bound Catalog and routing pairs, typed executor metadata, closed callable registry, evidence schemas, Mode C projection, Audit, citation and handoff seams already form an explicit extension path.
No evidence shows a need for runtime discovery, dynamic code loading, entry-point scanning, hot loading, third-party execution, or a marketplace.
A plugin framework would create new L4 code-execution, dependency, path, authorization and secret boundaries and would prematurely force L6 packaging decisions.

The smallest next step is a typed/declarative minimum contract plus explicit registrations and sync/conformance validators, without a second Catalog, source registry, executor registry, request language, Result/Audit system or MCP tool.

frozen_authority.l5_obligation: Define the minimum evidence-family extension contract before considering any plugin framework; do not add a new family merely to prove the architecture.

gaps_for_next_tranche.finding: No first-class canonical evidence_family_id or declared capability-to-family cardinality exists; family identity is reconstructed from capability IDs, evidence schema versions, source families and projector maps.

Capability/evidence-contract knowledge is repeated across lineage, loader, result, audit, markdown and citation modules. A typed explicit registration model or authoritative mapping plus validators is needed; dynamic discovery is not needed.

proposed_tranche_sequence: A1 - freeze minimum extension contract, family/capability relationship, applicability rules and version transitions
A2 - harden explicit registration authorities and synchronization validators without runtime discovery
A3 - schema, normalization, lineage, Result/Audit/citation/handoff projection conformance
A4 - integrate L1 operability, L2 replay/retention, L3 drift and L4 security/resource conformance plus Skill/guide sync
A5 - accept conformance of representative existing families; no new family
